question: What teaching is claimed as about to be given to the beloved one?
premises: That something is the arrangement of the row of yoginīs.
It is told to the beloved one.
inference: The arrangement of the row of yoginīs is to be told to the beloved one.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved one, I shall tell you the arrangement of the row of yoginīs.
